newsitems.title: Another Update Based on Your Feedback!
newsitems.author: Daniel Abdelnur
newsitems.contents: Another Update Based on Your Feedback! Our participation in Steam Next Fest has been incredibly productive! We've been keeping a close eye on players' experiences, watching videos and livestreams, reading comments on Discord and other communities, and gathering valuable feedback over the past few days.We're really happy to have this opportunity to connect with you and develop Mayday: The Survival Island in partnership with our community. We believe that listening to the people who play our game is one of the best ways to make it better.Based on the feedback we've received during Next Fest, we've prepared another update! We hope you enjoy these improvements:⚙️ Changes and Improvements📦 Items Now Stack Automatically When DroppedWe noticed that picking up items one by one was becoming repetitive and tedious, and that's not the experience we want to provide. Now, items of the same type that drop close to each other automatically stack together, allowing you to collect them all at once instead of picking up 5, 10, 15, or even more items individually!🟢 Slimes Nerfed and Removed from the Center of the IslandSlimes are the first enemies players encounter, and we noticed they were a little too difficult for this early stage of the game, when players are still learning the combat mechanics. So, we've made them weaker and removed them from the central area of the island, leaving more room to explore and gather resources.🔥 Forge: Reduced Iron Ingot CostWe've reduced the cost of building the forge from 5 to 3 iron ingots. We noticed that obtaining iron in the early stages of the game was a little more difficult than expected. This change aims to make early-game progression more balanced.🧵 Sewing Table Before the Drying FrameWe've adjusted the order of these structures to improve early-game progression and highlight the importance of the Sewing Table, which allows you to craft a new backpack and several other useful upgrades throughout your adventure.Thank you to everyone who's been playing the demo, sharing their experiences, and helping us make Mayday: The Survival Island a better game.Every comment, video, and suggestion helps us see the game from a new perspective. We're really happy to build this adventure together with you!See you on the island! 🏝️💚

newsitems.title: Mayday is in Steam Next Fest, with a big demo update!
newsitems.author: keking26
newsitems.contents: We're in Steam Next Fest! :tada:From October 19 to 26, Mayday: The Survival Island is part of the fest, and we've put a properly updated demo up for it. Six new features and improvements are waiting for you, including four things you've been asking us for!.You can move your buildings now!Grab the hammer and pick a construction up, then put it down somewhere better. Before this your only option was to tear it down and build it again, which hurt every single time.Build and decorate your houseRight-click with the hammer and a whole building menu opens up: walls, doors, floors, tables, chairs, rugs, vases and lots more. This is the one we're most excited about. Your shelter can finally be somewhere you made rather than somewhere you sleep. :green_heart:Make your home more comfortable!We've added a Comfort system! As you build and decorate your home, your Comfort level increases, unlocking bonuses as it grows, including more health, slower energy consumption, and other benefits. Your home isn't just about looks anymore. It also makes you stronger and helps you survive!Chests do the fetchingSo many of you asked for this. Anything sitting in a chest is used automatically when you craft, so no more running back and forth emptying boxes into your pockets.And chests upgrade in placeOnce your workbench is upgraded you can turn a small chest into a big one without destroying it first.Now available in more languages!We've added support for French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, and Spanish, making Mayday accessible to even more players around the world!Then the big one: November 2Mayday: The Survival Island releases on November 2, 2026, just one week after the fest closes! :tada: So this demo is a real look at a game that's nearly here.And one more thing. Forty thousand of you have wishlisted Mayday. For our first big project that still doesn't feel real, and we're so grateful. Thank you. :green_heart:And one more thing. Forty-five thousand of you have wishlisted Mayday. For our first big project, that still doesn't feel real, and we're so grateful. Thank you! 💚Play the demo this week and come and tell us what you think. We'll be reading every word.

newsitems.title: Mayday: The Survival Island launches November 2!
newsitems.author: Violet Crush
newsitems.contents: Mayday: The Survival Island launches November 2! Today is day one of PAX West in Seattle, and we couldn't think of a better moment to say it out loud: Mayday: The Survival Island releases on November 2, 2026. 🎉 After a mysterious crash you wake up alone on a remote island — injured, disoriented, and a long way from anyone. You hunt, farm, fish, craft, and build yourself a home. Then you push out into the archipelago and start finding out what else is out there, and what has been watching you since you arrived. 24 hand-crafted islands, and a story about a lost civilization waiting at the end of them. Play it at PAX West Mayday is at PAX West in Seattle from September 4–7, at the booth of our publisher indie.io — Booth #316. The demo is playable right there on the floor, and the indie.io team is there all four days and would love to hear what you think of it. 💚 We can't be there in person ourselves, so if you do get to play it, come and tell us about it on Discord — we'll be reading every word. Not in Seattle? Play it right now The demo is already available here on Steam — you can be playing it in the next five minutes, from wherever you are. Every piece of feedback we've had on the demo so far has gone straight into the game, so please keep it coming. Two buttons that genuinely help us Wishlist — so Steam tells you the moment we launch on November 2. Follow — so you actually see what we post between now and then. There's more coming before launch, and Follow is what puts it in front of you. Stay tuned with Mayday! Join the Discord to stay up to date with all the latest news! You can also find us on X, YouTube, Instagram, Bluesky and Facebook. Wishlist & Subscribe Don't forget to add Mayday: The Survival Island to your Wishlists! See you on the island — November 2.

newsitems.title: Official Publisher Announcement
newsitems.author: Daniel Abdelnur
newsitems.contents: Mayday just took a huge step!We’ve got some exciting news to share: we’ve officially partnered with indie.io! We’re thrilled to have the support of this amazing publisher, who will help us take Mayday even further, and deliver an even better experience for all of you!About game publishersFor those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.Why we chose indie.ioAt Pequi Studios, we believe that every great project needs a strong strategic partner. The team at indie.io shares our values and provides full support, allowing us to focus 100% of our energy on creating an incredible experience for the players of Mayday: The Survival Island.Check out other indie.io titlesThey’ve supported some amazing games — be sure to visit the indie.io Steam Publisher Page and take a look!Stay tuned with Mayday!Join the Discord to stay up to date with all the latest news!Wishlist & SubscribeDon’t forget to add Mayday: The Survival Island to your Wishlists!
